title: Rust: SenML pack/unpack
notes: Implemented complete allocation-free Rust SenML-CBOR pack/unpack without C/Zephyr. Replaced the upstream 8-field Record bottleneck with a source-compatible borrowed local Record covering all RFC 8428 fields: bn/bt/bu/bv/bs/bver/n/u/v/vs/vb/vd/s/t/ut. Encoder prevalidates names, finite numbers, bver 1..=10, and v/vs/vb/vd one-of before any output mutation; supports exact capacity reporting and definite byte strings. Decoder handles typed fields, all integer/float widths, duplicates, unknown numeric labels, optional string extensions, mandatory '_' extension rejection, malformed/trailing/capacity input, and no allocation. cbor compatibility API, Position, and IPSO callers remain green. Added shared senml_full_fields vector/schema with byte-exact Python/Rust encode/decode/re-encode consumers. Green: lichen-senml 21 unit + 15 integration tests, position SenML 4, fmt, all-target clippy -D warnings, no-default-features/no_std; Python parity/location/codec 61, ruff, mypy, both schemas.
close_reason: Complete RFC 8428 Rust SenML pack/unpack and cross-language vectors are green
